title: E0122: File inclusion with user input
plain_english: Using `include` or `require` with a path built from user-controlled input can allow an attacker to include unintended local or remote files.
why_matters: File inclusion vulnerabilities can: - Include and execute malicious PHP files (local or remote) - Expose sensitive files such as `/etc/passwd`, source code, or configuration files - Lead to remote code execution in some configurations
what_it_checks: `$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE` values used directly in include paths
